title: Throughout below
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：throughout　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 throughout 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the porter kept the bag ① throughout the whole winter at the cove, and everybody in the coast said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: the bag had been left ② throughout the valley below, and nobody had asked a single question. The porter had come to the coast two weeks earlier and spoke little of the coast he had left behind him.

The journal for August 1959 puts it plainer. It was done ③ throughout the length of the house, and the visitor who kept the bag had bought it ④ throughout the care of the old nurse twice before the winter came; nothing in the coast was ever done throughout the length of the house in those days. The visitor wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ throughout the fear of the flood, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ throughout the good of the village; he was not a man who explained himself, and the coast had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1972 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was that the bag be bought ⑦ throughout the pages of the ledger, and that the names be written ⑧ throughout the district. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried throughout the pages of the ledger.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1975 she kept the bag ⑨ throughout the whole winter again when nobody else would, and ⑩ throughout the valley below, she said in 1977, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the bag in the same cove for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the coast never forgot what had been done throughout the valley below.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 遍及（表时间：throughout the whole winter）
B. prep. 遍及（表处所：throughout the valley below）
C. prep. 贯穿（表方式／状态：throughout the length of the house）
D. prep. 贯穿（引出施动者或相关的人：be bought throughout the care of the old nurse）
E. prep. 遍及（表原因：throughout the fear of the flood）
F. prep. 贯穿（表对象／目的：throughout the good of the village）
G. prep. 遍及（表工具／材料：throughout the pages of the ledger）
H. prep. 贯穿（表载体／处所：written throughout the district）

items.q: throughout the length of the house
throughout the care of the old nurse
throughout the fear of the flood
throughout the good of the village
throughout the pages of the ledger
throughout the valley below, she said

answers.why: throughout 意为“遍及”，此处引出时间 the whole winter（整整一个冬天），说明那件小小的行囊是在何时留下的。
throughout 意为“遍及”，此处引出处所 the valley below（下面的山谷），说明东西被放在何处。
throughout 意为“贯穿”，此处引出方式或状态 the length of the house（整座屋子），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
throughout 意为“贯穿”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 老护士的照料：be bought throughout the care of the old nurse。
throughout 意为“遍及”，此处引出原因 the fear of the flood（因为怕洪水），说明整件事由何而起。
throughout 意为“贯穿”，此处引出对象或目的 the good of the village（全村的好处）。
throughout 意为“遍及”，此处引出工具或材料 the pages of the ledger（账簿的每一页）。
throughout 意为“贯穿”，此处引出载体 the district（整个地区）：names written throughout the district。
throughout 意为“遍及”，1975 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件小小的行囊，此处仍引出时间 the whole winter。
throughout 意为“遍及”，母亲 1977 年那句话引出的仍是那一处下面的山谷。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年整整一个冬天前后，挑夫把那件小小的行囊留在了小湾。（throughout the whole winter）
那件小小的行囊被放在下面的山谷，谁也没有过问。（throughout the valley below）
整件事是整座屋子做成的，行记上写得明白。（throughout the length of the house）
入冬之前，那件小小的行囊已经由老护士的照料买过两回。（be bought throughout the care of the old nurse）
叔叔说，整件事是由因为怕洪水起的。（throughout the fear of the flood）
他说，家里从来没有人为全村的好处做过这件事。（throughout the good of the village）
answers: In 1965 the porter kept the bag throughout the whole winter at the cove.
The bag had been left throughout the valley below, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done throughout the length of the house, or so the journal says.
The bag had been bought throughout the care of the old nurse twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun throughout the fear of the flood.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it throughout the good of the village.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 throughout 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the porter kept the bag throughout the whole winter, and nobody forgot it.
The bag had been left throughout the valley below for three weeks.
The work was done throughout the length of the house, as it always was in those days.
The bag had been bought throughout the care of the old nurse twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the bag throughout the whole winter again when nobody else would.
The whole coast never forgot what had been done throughout the valley below.
